The seat became vacant on January 5, 2026, when incumbent [[Marjorie Taylor Greene]] resigned.{{cite web|url=https://www.cnn.com/2025/11/21/politics/marjorie-taylor-greene-resign-in-january|title=GOP Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene to resign in January|last=Iyer|first=Kaanita|date=November 21, 2025|access-date=November 21, 2025|website=[[CNN]]}} Under Georgia law, [[Nonpartisan primary|all candidates appeared on one ballot]] in the March 10, 2026 special election. As no candidate received more than 50% of the vote, a runoff election between district attorney [[Clay Fuller]] and cattleman Shawn Harris was held on April 7, 2026,{{cite news |title=Georgia race to replace Marjorie Taylor Greene heads to a runoff |first=Kayla |last=Epstein |work=[[BBC News]] |date=March 11, 2026 |access-date=March 17, 2026 |url=https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cy4wknrz3exo}} with Fuller winning to serve the remainder of the [[119th United States Congress]], ending January 3, 2027.{{Cite web |date=2026-04-07 |title=2026 Georgia U.S. House Nonpartisan Special Runoff Election Election Live Results |url=https://apnews.com/projects/elections-2026/georgia-special-general-runoff-results-us-house-district-14/ |access-date=2026-04-08 |website=AP News |language=en}} == Background == On November 21, 2025, Greene announced her resignation from Congress effective January 5, 2026, citing her disagreements with President [[Donald Trump]] over his handling of the [[Jeffrey Epstein client list|Epstein files]].{{cite web|url=https://www.cbsnews.com/news/marjorie-taylor-greene-resigning-from-congress/|title=Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene says she's resigning from Congress|last=Walsh|first=Joe|date=November 21, 2025|access-date=November 21, 2025|website=[[CBS News]]}} The following day, [[Governor of Georgia|Governor]] [[Brian Kemp]] scheduled a special election for March 10, 2026, with a runoff set for April 7 if no candidate received a majority of the vote.{{cite news|url = https://thehill.com/homenews/campaign/5675057-kemp-georgia-special-election-marjorie-taylor-greene-seat/|title = Kemp sets date for special election to fill remainder of Marjorie Taylor Greene’s term |last = Mueller|first = Julia|work = [[The Hill (newspaper)|The Hill]]|date = January 6, 2026|access-date = January 7, 2026}} == Candidates == === Republican Party === ==== Advanced to runoff ==== *[[Clay Fuller]], former district attorney for the Lookout Mountain Judicial Circuit (2020–2026) and candidate for this district in [[2020 United States House of Representatives elections in Georgia#District 14|2020]]{{cite news |last1=FAHLBERG |first1=AUDREY |title=Clayton Fuller to Run for MTG's Congressional Seat|url=https://www.nationalreview.com/corner/exclusive-lookout-mountain-district-attorney-clay-fuller-to-run-for-mtgs-congressional-seat/|access-date=December 30, 2025 |work=[[The National Review]] |date=November 25, 2025 |language=en}} ====Eliminated in first round==== *Star Black, former [[Federal Emergency Management Agency]] official{{cite news |last1=Perez |first1=Ignacio |title=With Greene stepping down, who are the Republicans seeking her seat?
